browser.interactionBoundary: Fixture import, asset editing, placement, Inspector edits, direct resize, Prefab creation/placement, validation, Play, Save/Load, and exports were performed through visible editor controls. No project state was injected during this dogfood run.

checks.evidence: Started Blank and imported both fixtures with Import as Sprite.
Defined asymmetric 8/16/6/12 source-pixel guides and observed the 3x3 preview overlay.
Placed and named simple, normal, wide, tall, tiny, Flip X, Flip Y, and atlas instances.
Dragged the selected Sprite right handle; visible size changed from 3.00x2.00 to 3.64x2.00 while guide metadata stayed unchanged.
Set atlas Left to 60 with Right 16 on a 64px region. Validate Project reported sprite-nine-slice-guides-invalid and sprite-nine-slice-horizontal-bounds.
Entered Play with invalid guides; the scene stayed running and the invalid nine-slice renderer used the documented Simple fallback.
Restored Left to 8; Validate Project returned No structured authoring issues found.
Saved as Phase 026 Nine-Slice Dogfood, reloaded the browser, loaded the saved slot, and observed all eight named Sprite records.
Saved Nine-Slice Panel Prefab, placed three linked instances, and edited them to normal, wide, and tiny sizes.
Final visible Validate Project returned No structured authoring issues found.
Playable export visibly reported completion; editable export entered its normal build flow without browser console warnings or errors.
phase-026-export-proof.json records editable and playable standalone files, eight Sprite records, finite cell geometry, offline boot, editor availability only in editable output, and no errors.

authoringChoice: Guide editing is numeric with a visual overlay. Draggable guide lines were intentionally omitted because they would conflict with the existing source-region drag surface; this was explicitly permitted by the phase brief.
